reason: Resolve startup mixture and unequal achieved false-isolation rates, and test whether the narrow cache-mean signal survives correctly correlated sequential baselines
half_life_selection: normal design split, age-only MSE after warmup; shared by all detectors
threshold_tuning_rule: on own NORMAL tuning trajectories recompute phase-wise 95th percentile of episode max score/base threshold, preserving common phase/edge normal model; no MSE-based detector choice
whitening: at each age compute the last block of Cholesky inverse applied to current centered legal prefix; use current/past residuals only. Accumulate these causal innovations without revising their past values
distribution_warning: empirical conditional-Gaussian approximation, no guaranteed exact independent innovation model under nonlinear feedback; all methods empirically calibrated by complete-episode maxima
primary: mean vs each of white_window,white_cusum,white_signed_cusum on primary edge step/half_step under both schedules:12 tests of >=1% receiver totalMSE improvement; Holm family0.05
continuation: At least two of the four primary schedule/scenario cells pass against all three sequential baselines, and the external edge shows no >2% degradation on the corresponding cells; otherwise do not promote mean as a distinct method
other_results: instant comparator, low bias, matched replay, external edge all reported; do not replace failed primary gate with isolated favorable comparisons
stop: Run once after checks; no tuning from audit/test outputs. If equally calibrated CUSUM/window explains gains, stop standalone algorithm novelty and retain platform/principled comparison
scope: one predefined full-local-observability heterogeneous model; multiple schedules/edge directions; uncertainty conditional on trained models
